from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEPSRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's basic earnings per share for the reporting period."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Security code (证券代码)")
    basic_earnings_per_share: float | None = Field(description="Basic EPS value in yuan per share (基本每股收益元/股)")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_eps_records: list[CompanyEPSRecord]
